requirements.details: The programme spans six full-time semesters. Follow the prerequisite sequence from Year 1 to Year 3. The exit point is the end of Year 3 at Level 6.

requirements.details: Pass the Fiji School Leaving Certificate after twelve years of continuous schooling or an equivalent qualification with 200/400. English and three science or technology subjects must each reach 50%.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Engineering and Technical Vocational Education and Training · pp. 65

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Engineering and Technical Vocational Education and Training · pp. 66, 69
